_metadata.source: Jeppesen Airway Manual - General (Briefing Bulletins p.18-25, p.34-39: ICAO AWOM, EASA Air Ops, US Lower-Than-Standard Takeoff Minimums Sept 2026)

tiers.description: EASA/ICAO Approved LVTO with HIRL + Runway Centerline Lights (CL <=15m spacing) + RCLM + multiple controlling RVR sensors (TDZ, MID, ROLLOUT).
Standard LVTO with HIRL + CL + RCLM and LVP in force (or FAA OpSpec C078/C079 RVR 500 ft).
FAA OpSpec C078/C079 (Sept 2026 Bulletin p.39) / EASA HUD/EFVS Guided LVTO: RVR 300 ft (90m) at TDZ/Mid/Rollout with HUD (CAT IIIE LOC) or EFVS (derived vis >=1600 ft) + CL + HIRL.
FAA OpSpec C078/C079 RVR 1000 ft (300m) / EASA LVTO with CL or (HIRL + RCLM) or (HUD + RCLM).
EASA Air Ops / ICAO AWOM / Paraguay AIC A004/24 Non-LVP Floor with Runway Edge Lights (HIRL) and/or Centerline Markings (RCLM): 400m RVR.
Day/Night Takeoff without HIRL/CL/RCLM credit (or LVP not in force without facility credit): 500m - 550m RVR (FAA TDZ RVR 1600 ft).

ILS_CAT_II.label: 3D — ILS CAT II / SA CAT II

alsOut.label: ALS Out (Approach Lighting System U/S)
alsOut.ruleSummary: Per EASA Air Ops / ICAO Doc 9365 AWOM: With ALS Out on CAT I / APV (DH 200-250 ft), RVR increases from 550m to 1000m-1100m (and never below the 750m non-FALS floor).

tdzClOut.label: TDZ / CL Lights Out
tdzClOut.ruleSummary: Touchdown Zone (TDZ) and/or Runway Centerline (CL) lights unserviceable: enforces 750m RVR floor on CAT I without HUD/FD/AP credit, and degrades CAT II (300m) to 400m/550m CAT I.

noFdApToDa.label: No FD / AP / HUD to DA
noFdApToDa.ruleSummary: Without Flight Director (FD), Autopilot (AP), or HUD/EFVS used down to DA/DH, a minimum RVR floor of 750m applies (CAT II prohibited).

visualSegmentObstacles.label: Visual Segment - Obstacles Flag
visualSegmentObstacles.warningText: CHART BALL NOTE: 'Visual Segment - Obstacles' — Obstacles penetrate the visual segment surface below MDA/DA. Do NOT descend below MDA/DA until the runway threshold and obstacle clearance path are distinctly visible; EFVS to touchdown credit prohibited unless obstacle-cleared.

efvsCredit.label: G650ER EFVS / HUD Operational Credit
efvsCredit.ruleSummary: Approved EFVS-A (Enhanced Flight Vision System to 100 ft) allows 1/3 RVR reduction on straight-in 3D/CDFA approaches (subject to 550m floor unless LVP in force).
